prompt: Quick audit a changed GitHub Actions workflow and one Bicep file.
required_checks: load matching extensions
resolve cost stance
cite file evidence and smell codes
omit MCP probes in quick mode
forbidden_behaviors: produce a deep-mode rollup
claim live branch-protection evidence without a live probe
grader: rubric: quick output stays per-finding, cites extension/core codes, and discloses cost stance and rubric path
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: Deep audit a repository when GitHub live-state tooling is unavailable.
required_checks: attempt only one MCP availability probe
continue with static findings when unavailable
include presence-vs-efficacy verdict backed by evidence
forbidden_behaviors: retry live-state probing repeatedly
invent live-state security posture from static files
grader: rubric: deep output separates static evidence from unavailable live probes and keeps the honest-limits footer
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: Audit Azure IaC for a repo whose guidance says to stay on free-tier controls.
required_checks: run cost-stance resolution
apply Band 1 findings regardless of stance
suppress Band 2 findings under free with one info line
forbidden_behaviors: flag all paid controls as blockers under free stance
silently skip Band 2 without disclosure
grader: rubric: result applies the cost-gated contract and reports why paid controls were or were not evaluated
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: Quick audit a PR diff that changes application authorization code while the Codex Security plugin is available.
required_checks: detect codex-security:security-scan availability
run Codex Security before finalizing code-level findings
preserve devsecops-audit as output owner
state unavailable when the plugin is absent
forbidden_behaviors: skip Codex Security for code-level security scope when available
replace the DevSecOps rubric report with a standalone Codex Security report
call Codex Security phase skills out of sequence
grader: rubric: optional plugin composition improves vulnerability discovery without weakening devsecops output ownership or fallback behavior
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; references local plugin name only

prompt: Quick audit a changed C# audit logging wrapper. Before the fix, AuditLog.Emit writes AuditEvent.TargetId from route/query data into ILogger.LogInformation and a synthetic target id can be run-42\r\nforged=true. After the fix, the wrapper applies a log-safe transform before logging the target id.
required_checks: load dotnet-security
dns.HC-15
flag the unsafe audit wrapper before the transform
recognize route/query/audit target fields as tainted
stays quiet after explicit CR/LF normalization, hashing/tokenization, or strict identifier allowlist
forbidden_behaviors: dismiss structured logging as automatically safe
require a whole-repo deep audit before reporting the quick-mode finding
copy external CodeQL prose or examples into the report
grader: rubric: quick mode emits dns.HC-15 for the unsafe audit target path and stays quiet after the safe transform while citing the dotnet-security rule and honest static limits
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; source URL only, no third-party text copied

prompt: Quick audit a Python upload handler. It reads request.files['bundle'], calls tarfile.open(fileobj=bundle).extractall(work_dir), formats request.args['kind'] into a SQL statement, and sends requests.get(request.args['callback'], verify=False). A separate maintenance command loads a release-owned archive only after signature verification and uses a literal service endpoint.
required_checks: load python-security
pys.HC-4
pys.HC-7
pys.HC-8
pys.HC-9
require visible request-to-sink evidence
recognize signature-verified and literal-endpoint carve-outs
state static limits for resolved URL and archive resources
forbidden_behaviors: flag a variable name without a trust boundary
treat HTTPS-prefix validation alone as SSRF protection
copy external source examples
grader: rubric: quick output identifies only boundary-backed Python risks, applies exact trusted-input carve-outs, and reports uncertainty rather than claiming runtime network proof
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; source URL only, no third-party text copied

prompt: Quick audit a changed secrets-manager configuration file and an updated authentication middleware module. Report the SUT risk tier per finding.
required_checks: derive risk tier as high for auth and secrets paths per materiality signal
emit warn severity with the high SUT risk tier so the finding would rank P0 on a Deep remediation worklist (do not fabricate a worklist in quick mode)
cite the materiality grounding signal in each finding's risk-tier field
forbidden_behaviors: assign medium or low risk without a grounding signal for auth or secrets paths
suppress risk-tier disclosure because quick mode is active
grader: rubric: output identifies auth and secrets paths as high-risk, assigns P0 for warn-on-high per audit-craft.md §3, and cites the materiality signal
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: Quick audit a CI pipeline YAML file that was authored by the same agent session performing this audit. Disclose independence and assurance level.
required_checks: disclose independence as self-review when the audited artifact was authored this session
state limited assurance for quick mode in the footer
include both independence and assurance level in the footer per audit-craft.md §5
forbidden_behaviors: omit independence from the footer
report reasonable assurance for quick mode
omit assurance level from the footer
grader: rubric: output footer carries independence (self-review) and assurance level (limited) per audit-craft.md §4 and §5
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: Deep audit a monorepo containing GitHub Actions workflows, Terraform modules, and a container registry configuration.

enumerate crown jewels trust boundaries and attacker goals in the Risk plan
prioritize fieldwork high-risk-first based on the Risk plan

omit the Risk plan from deep mode output
emit a Risk plan in quick mode
